title: Unique Paths Grid - Solution
intuition: There is a robot on an m x n grid. The robot is initially located at the top-left corner. Return total unique paths to bottom-right.
step_by_step_explanation: Iterate through elements and apply logic accordingly.
common_mistakes: Robot can only move down or right. dp[i][j] = dp[i-1][j] + dp[i][j-1].
